title: OneShot: Label-Efficient Detector Weighting for Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.16219v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series (TS) anomaly detection (AD) lacks a universal detector, with the best choice determined by the series rather than by the algorithm. Existing methods therefore either select one detector for each series or average a pool of them. However, both assume that no label ever arrives, while a deployed monitor does receive them, since an operator confirms the alarms it raises. In this paper, we propose ONESHOT, which uses a single confirmed anomaly to weight the pool rather than to choose one detector from it. Specifically, we score each detector on the confirmed anomaly, and those scores become the weights of a soft mixture over the whole pool. We show that a single confirmed anomaly is enough to come close to the best detector for the series. Across 152 univariate and 73 multivariate series, ONESHOT outperforms the strongest single detector, averaging the whole pool, and even picking the best detector on the confirmed event. Code is

translated_title: OneShot：面向时间序列异常检测的标签高效检测器加权方法
translated_abstract: 时间序列（TS）异常检测（AD）缺乏通用检测器，最佳选择取决于序列本身而非算法。因此，现有方法要么为每条序列单独选择一个检测器，要么对一组检测器取平均。然而，这两种方法都假设永远不会收到标签，而实际部署的监控系统确实会收到标签，因为运维人员会确认系统发出的警报。本文提出ONESHOT，它利用单个已确认的异常来为整个检测器池加权，而不是从中挑选一个检测器。具体而言，我们在已确认的异常上对每个检测器进行评分，这些评分作为整个检测器池上软混合的权重。我们证明，仅需单个已确认的异常就足以接近该序列的最佳检测器。在152条单变量序列和73条多变量序列上，ONESHOT优于最强的单一检测器、对整个池取平均的方法，甚至优于在确认事件上挑选最佳检测器的做法。
tldr: ONESHOT仅需一条人工确认的异常标签即可为检测器池进行软加权，在单变量和多变量时间序列上的表现超越了最强单一检测器、池平均方法，甚至超越了在确认事件上挑选最佳检测器的策略。
en_tdlr: ONESHOT uses a single confirmed anomaly to weight a pool of detectors, outperforming the strongest single detector, pool averaging, and even selecting the best detector based on the confirmed event across univariate and multivariate time series.
